CVE-2023-24607.title: Qt before 6.4.3 allows a denial of service via a crafted string w ...
CVE-2023-24607.description: Qt before 6.4.3 allows a denial of service via a crafted string when the SQL ODBC driver plugin is used and the size of SQLTCHAR is 4. The affected versions are 5.x before 5.15.13, 6.x before 6.2.8, and 6.3.x before 6.4.3.

CVE-2025-23050.title: QLowEnergyController in Qt before 6.8.2 mishandles malformed Blue ...
CVE-2025-23050.description: QLowEnergyController in Qt before 6.8.2 mishandles malformed Bluetooth ATT commands, leading to an out-of-bounds read (or division by zero). This is fixed in 5.15.19, 6.5.9, and 6.8.2.

CVE-2025-5683.title: When loading a specifically crafted ICNS format image file in QIm ...
CVE-2025-5683.description:
When loading a specifically crafted ICNS format image file in QImage then it will trigger a crash. 

This issue affects Qt from versions 6.3.0 through 6.5.9, from 6.6.0 through 6.8.4, 6.9.0. This is fixed in 6.5.10, 6.8.5 and 6.9.1.

CVE-2026-103653.title: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Qt CoAP message parsin ...
CVE-2026-103653.description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the Qt CoAP message parsing (QCoapInternalReply::createFromFrame()) of the Qt CoAP module. Processing a malformed CoAP message can cause an application using Qt CoAP to crash (loss of availability) or to continue operating on incorrect data (potential loss of integrity).

CVE-2026-107472.title: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the QTextCodec TSCII encod ...
CVE-2026-107472.description: An out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the QTextCodec TSCII encoding of the Qt 5 Compatibility APIs module (Qt Core in Qt 5 and earlier) impacts Qt. Applications that convert text to the TSCII encoding through QTextCodec may read memory outside the input buffer, which can cause the application to crash or misinterpret the data.

CVE-2026-107479.description: An integer truncation vulnerability in the QTextCodec conversion functions of the Qt 5 Core Compatibility APIs module impacts the Qt Framework. An application using the affected functionality could crash.

CVE-2026-107590.title: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Qt QTextCodec iconv-b ...
CVE-2026-107590.description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the Qt QTextCodec iconv-based encoding of the Qt 5 Compatibility APIs module (Qt Core in Qt 5 and earlier) impacts Qt. Under certain conditions, encoding text with QTextCodec may write outside an internal buffer. This can cause the application to crash and may affect data integrity.

CVE-2026-16762.title: An attacker able to supply a crafted XML document to an applicati ...
CVE-2026-16762.description: An attacker able to supply a crafted XML document to an application using QXmlStreamReader can cause disproportionate CPU consumption during parsing, making the application unresponsive (denial of service). Exploitation requires only that the application parse attacker-influenced XML; no authentication, privileges, or user interaction beyond ingesting the input are needed. There is no loss of confidentiality or integrity — no data disclosure, data modification, or code execution — and the impact is contained to the affected process.

CVE-2026-96432.title: A malicious or compromised HTTP/2 server withholding SETTINGS ACK ...
CVE-2026-96432.description: A malicious or compromised HTTP/2 server withholding SETTINGS ACK can send RST_STREAM on a completed stream, planting a null pointer, and then send a PUSH_PROMISE for that stream, causing a null pointer dereference in the QNetworkAccessManager class of the Qt Network module that crashes the application.
